neighbours.label: an abstract trait or knowledge noun (skills, knowledge, wisdom, traits) that is being preserved or passed on to others, as against the same nouns merely described and concrete objects passed on
fire: Over many generations the village elders preserved the wisdom of their ancestors.
Each master potter handed his techniques down to a single apprentice.
Medieval scribes kept alive the knowledge of Greek medicine.
The plant breeders tried to transfer drought-resistance traits into wheat.
After the war, the veterans taught their skills to younger mechanics.
Islamic scholars translated and preserved the ideas of Aristotle.
The coach hoped to pass her experience on to the new players.
Through careful selection, farmers passed these useful qualities to later herds.
quiet: Over many generations the village elders preserved the wooden bridge near the mill.
Each master potter handed his apron to a single apprentice.
Medieval scribes worked by candlelight in cold rooms.
The plant breeders tried to grow wheat on the dry hillside.
After the war, the veterans sold their trucks to younger mechanics.
Islamic scholars built a large library in Baghdad.
The coach hoped to hand her whistle on to the new trainer.
Through careful selection, farmers sold these useful cows to later buyers.
